title: (No AI) Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/02/STK171_VRG_Illo_15_Normand_ElonMusk_15.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

xAI's Grokipedia, an online encyclopedia with AI-generated articles that Elon Musk once promised would be a ["massive improvement"](https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1972992095859433671?lang=en) over Wikipedia, apparently hasn't been updated since April 24th, [according to a report from _Lawfare_](https://www.lawfaremedia.org/article/grokipedia-stopped-reviewing-edits-in-april.-it-didn-t-tell-anyone). "As far as we can tell, no entry has changed in more than three months," _Lawfare_ said.

Grokipedia launched in v0.1 [in October 2025](https://www.theverge.com/news/807686/elon-musk-grokipedia-launch-wikipedia-xai-copied) with an initial batch of 885,000 articles, and is now on v0.2 (released [in November 2025](https://grokipedia.com/page/Grokipedia_version_02)) and has more than 6,000,000 total articles, [according to grokipedia.com/live](https://grokipedia.com/live). title: (No AI) Sure seems like Fenix Flexin used AI music generator Treblo
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![The seemingly AI generated cover art for Fenix Flexin’s Rubberz.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/artworks-WsdIgVXV8NOV-0-t1080x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

And you thought we were done with this one… | Image: Fenix Flexin

We were pretty sure that [Fenix Flexin's "Rubberz"](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/974209/fenix-flexin-billboard-hot-100-rubberz-ai-slop) was made using AI, but musician [Medasin](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dbbf1vCBuGO/) was confident that it was made using Treblo specifically. Now the company and a new [detection tool](https://treblo.com/detect) seem to confirm it.

On Monday, the company announced the open-source [Treblo AI Music Classifier](https://treblo.com/blog/treblo-ai-music-classifier), which detects when a song was generated using Treblo, though not other AI tools. According to a blog post, it has a false positive rate of less than 1 in 10,000. That's not unimpeachable, but it's notable that the company's own Classifier determined that "Rubberz" was "very likely Treblo" with "high confidence," adding more fuel to the PR nightmare for Fenix.

…

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/975528/fenix-flexin-ai-music-generator-treblo)
